title: matching(identifier:)
resolved_authoritative_text:
Returns a new query that matches elements that have an identifying property that matches a provided identifier.A string to match against any one of each element’s identifying properties: identifier, title, label, value, or placeholderValue.
A new query that defines a search that extends the search criteria of the receiver. The new search matches elements that match the original search and have an identifying property that matches a provided identifier.
applicability: The inspected XCTest API used by V10 diagnostics at DSC01OSAppSettings.swift.in101–105 matches more than the actual identifier property. It is not equivalent to a label predicate or necessarily to identifier-or-label. Exact pinned26.5 headers/runtime applicability still subject to actual future observed predicate/attribute guards.
